# Return a detached Web Desktop app after its native window dwells over the desktop

## Context

During the 23 November release test Tobi confirmed that dragging a Web Desktop app out and back in one held gesture works. He then requested the other Dock Layouts interaction: after releasing the app as a real native popup, drag its OS window over the source view and let the existing dwell timer bring it back.

## The Problem

`Neo.desktop.WindowTearOut` currently retains the popup after pointer release. **Back to desktop** restores the original body and task, but moving that native frame back over its desktop does not initiate a timed return.

## The Architectural Reality

The shared Dock mechanism already observes actual native frame movement through `WindowPosition`, `manager.Window` and `manager.DragCoordinator`. Dock registers the moving window as a native source and supplies eligible target geometry and a terminal drop callback. The desktop already has a fenced native handle, an owning workspace, and a tested `returnToDesktop` path. [Design discussion](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/21204) · [original implementation](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/22067).

## The Fix

Register the committed popup and its owning desktop with the existing native movement/dwell machinery. Route a successful dwell to the established return transaction. Preserve the workspace's own admission and cleanup across reload, close and sign-out.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Moving a released native popup over the original desktop workspace and dwelling returns the same app exactly once, with its current content and one task. The original held-pointer out-and-back gesture and the explicit return button still work.
- [ ] Startup placement alone cannot trigger a return. Leaving before the dwell expires cancels it. A different desktop and an obsolete popup handle cannot accept it.
- [ ] A real browser-window geometry test distinguishes actual OS-frame movement from DOM pointer drag and exercises success and cancellation; document any platform observation requiring a real mouse.

Design authority: Tobi’s Web Desktop manual test on 23 November. `#13028` implements native reintegration for Dock; `#21603` delivered the desktop's earlier pointer gesture. Latest-open and all-state same-surface searches found no existing desktop native-dwell delivery ticket. Emmy is coordinating implementation; the human merge and cut gates remain with Tobi.
